title: Ropa Rokutanga Rakadururwa Mugodo
intro: Fungidzira mazuva ekutanga evanhu, apo nyika yese yaive mhuri imwe chete. Unoona zvipiriso zviviri zvichiiswa pamberi paAllah - chimwe chichigamuchirwa, chimwe chichirambwa. Godo rinodzika midzi mumoyo, uye kutyisidzira kunozevezwa nehasha. Zvinotevera zvichasiya chiratidzo munhoroondo nekusingaperi, uye kunyange shiri diki ichava mudzidzisi.
clues: Ndakapa mupiro kuna Allah, asi wangu hauna kugamuchirwa apo mumwe mupiro wakagamuchirwa.
Ndakataura negodo ndikatyisidzira kuti ndaizouraya munhu.
Ndakauraya vanhu vasina kururama kekutanga panyika.
Ndakaona gunguo richikwenya pasi kuti rindiratidze mavanzire emutumbi.
Ndakasara ndizere nekuzvidemba ndikava pakati pevakarasikirwa nezvakaitwa nemaoko angu.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
